title: Choucroute - Shortcut
description:
F&W's Kay Chun makes her shortcut choucroute with only five ingredients, not counting salt and pepper.
When I make it, I first sauté a sliced onion with a little cut-up bacon for a few minutes, then add some chopped garlic, and finish with the rest of the ingredients, and maybe a little white wine or vermouth.
ingredients: 1 pound or so mixed sausages, such as bratwurst and fresh chorizo, or smoked kielbasa, or garlic sausage, or …
1 pound small Yukon Gold or fingerling potatoes, cut-up to bite-sized pieces
Crusty bread and grainy mustard, for serving
directions: Preheat the oven to 425°. In a large cast-iron (or blue steel!) skillet, toss the sausages with the potatoes, sauerkraut, olive oil and caraway seeds; season with salt and pepper.
Roast until the potatoes are golden and cooked through, about 30 minutes or a little longer.
Serve the sausage choucroute with crusty bread and mustard.
Pair this dish with a ripe, lightly off-dry Alsace Riesling. Or, maybe a beer.
